Steps To Reproduce

On any desktop client / web client / mobile client

  1. Go to 'Send'

  2. Click on 'Create new send'

  3. Select file type

  4. Create a Send with a deletion date far in the future for example : 31/12/2050 23:59

  5. Save it

  6. Open the send to edit the name or whatever (except the deletion date)

  7. Save it

Expected Result

Either you can create or edit a send with a deletion date far in the future, restrict the date at the creation already.

Actual Result

Creation goes fine, then the edit is cancelled because deletion date too far in the future

Screenshots or Videos

Additional Context

Way back (maybe 1 year ago) I was able to add AND edit file sends with a really far deletion date.
